notes: Seed URL redirects to www.llanocounty.gov; results are listed on the Elections Archive page (some files on newtools.cira.state.tx.us). No Clarity site (elections.json 404). Every election-night file is a county 'Cumulative Results Report'; the only precinct report among the three elections is the official one for 2024 (15 Nov 2024). Last-Modified differs per file.
tag_rationale: All three elections are LATER by check 2 (county cumulative reports only on election night), so the tag is COUNTY_ONLY_PRECINCT_AT_CANVASS; each has a printed run time and an upload time on election night, so confidence is med.
